fusions.name: Dealt Five Cards
fusions.desc: Flicks 5 cards out in a fan; each deals 2 damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Signed Off
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A steady stroke of the pen that deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Ballot
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Copperplate Script
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 8%.
